name: mc_plan
title: Plan and preview a build
description:
Validates and simulates a build (direct or blueprint) without writing: bounds, final material counts, changes to existing non-air cells, clearing, overlaps, door/bed pairing errors and advisory support warnings, plus an optional preview image of the final scene (flat map colours or an angled schematic).

WHEN TO USE: optional escalation when the user asks for a preview or strict site analysis, or a concrete placement risk needs checking (collisions with terrain or structures, missing halves or supports, a transformed blueprint); not a routine step before every build.
WHEN NOT TO USE: to place blocks (mc_build), to look at existing terrain (mc_survey, mc_render) or to verify placed blocks (mc_verify, opt-in).

PARAMETERS: build takes mc_build's arguments. image defaults true; image:false skips the preview read. preview: view (top/north/south/east/west/slice/isometric/perspective), camera, scale 0-16, grid 0-64, slice. Invalid requests are rejected before analysis; pairing errors give valid:false. Protected overlaps appear as `protected` rows with protectedPass (build.override marks them overridden). Support and overwritten non-air findings are advisory.

SIDE EFFECTS: no writes, snapshots or commands; reads may load chunks. Not a reservation, and fluids, connections, entities and concurrent edits are not simulated.

build.description: mc_build's arguments (same fields and rules; see mc_build), validated exactly as mc_build validates them.

camera.description: Angled views only: azimuth (compass, north=0, east=90; default 135), elevation (default 35.26 isometric, 30 perspective), fov (perspective only, default 50).
